label: Xero alerts
description: Open problems that need the merchant: Xero refuses the connection, or documents could not be created. A new record e-mails the store's administrators.

key.label: Kind
key.description: connection or documents. Unique, so a problem that repeats updates the same record.

app_id.label: App
app_id.description: The app's record id in this store. The e-mail links to the app's pages with it.
